Venue: Bitget
Headline: CFD Super Wednesday (Round 4): Call XAUUSD up or down. Share a prize pool of up to $10,000!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
CFD Super Wednesday (Round 4) is live! Call XAUUSD up or down. Share a prize pool of up to $10,000! Winning or losing, both sides get paid.
Campaign Duration: 2026.11.18 21:00 - 2026.11.25 21:00 (UTC+8)
JOIN NOW
## How to Join
Complete CFD tasks during the campaign to earn prediction chances.
The prize pool is tiered by total participation. Once unique participants across both sides reach 50, 100, 300, 500, and 1,000, the pool unlocks at $1,000, $3,000, $5,000, $8,000, and $10,000 respectively.
When the campaign closes, both sides get paid: the winning side splits 70% of the total unlocked prize pool, the losing side splits 30% of the total unlocked prize pool.
## Tasks
Task 1: Complete your first CFD trade. First trade ≥ 0.01 lot, instrument: XAUUSD. Earn 2 prediction chances.
Task 2: Reach ≥ 0.5 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 1 prediction chance.
Task 3: Reach ≥ 2 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 2 prediction chances.
Task 4: Reach ≥ 5 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 5 prediction chances.
Task 5: Reach ≥ 10 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 5 prediction chances.
Task 6: Reach ≥ 15 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 5 prediction chances.
Task 7: Reach ≥ 20 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 5 prediction chances.
Task 8: Reach ≥ 30 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 10 prediction chances.
Task 9: Reach ≥ 45 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 15 prediction chances.
Task 10: Reach ≥ 60 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 15 prediction chances.
Task 11: Reach ≥ 80 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 15 prediction chances.
Task 12: Reach ≥ 100 cumulative lots bought on CFD, covering metals, forex. Earn 15 prediction chances.
## Notes
This promotion is only available in select regions. Users must use the Join Now button to complete registration before they can participate.
Trading lot size is calculated based on actual CFD positions opened during the promotion period; pending orders that are not filled and canceled orders will not be counted.
Rewards will be distributed to eligible accounts within 5 working days after the promotion ends.
This promotion is exclusive to regular users. Sub-accounts, institutional users, PRO accounts, and market makers are not eligible to participate.
All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's terms and conditions. Bitget reserves the right to disqualify any user from participating in the promotion and confiscate their rewards if any fraudulent conduct, illegal activities (such as using multiple accounts to claim rewards), or other violations are found.
Bitget will conduct a review of all users and promptly disqualify those who employ any technical means, including but not limited to electronic, robotic, repetitive, or automated methods, for the purpose of automated or repeated registration and participation, and confiscate their rewards.
Due to legal and regulatory requirements, some users may be unable to sign up for a Bitget account, or access may be temporarily restricted in certain countries or regions. Refer to Bitget's terms and conditions for the latest information.
Bitget reserves the right to amend, revise, or cancel this promotion at any time without prior notice, at its sole discretion. Bitget reserves the right to the final interpretation of this promotion. Contact customer service if you have any questions.

Headline: Apply for a Bitget Wallet Card for a chance to win the 500 USDC grand prize

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Bitget Wallet Card is a crypto payment card designed for everyday spending. You can use it for shopping, dining, travel, and online purchases. Pay with your crypto without repeatedly depositing or withdrawing funds, and enjoy up to 3% assetback on every purchase.
Bitget Wallet Card is now available in over 50 countries and regions, covering Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, Africa, South Asia, and more.
Apply now
## Exclusive event for Bitget Exchange users is now live!
1. Chance to win the 500 USDC grand prize
During the campaign, use referral code Bitget2026 to apply for your first Bitget Wallet Card and reach an eligible spend of at least $5 in total. If the campaign reaches 1,000 eligible participants, one participant will be selected through a draw to receive 500 USDC. The more you spend with your card, the higher your chance of winning.
2. Up to $25 in card rewards
During the campaign, use referral code Bitget2026 to apply for your first Bitget Wallet Card and reach an eligible spend of at least $5 in total to receive a 5 USDC reward. This reward is limited to the first 1,000 eligible participants on a first-come, first-served basis, while rewards last.
This can be combined with the existing new-user spending reward of up to $20, bringing your total card rewards to up to $25. The existing reward is subject to its own campaign rules.
Join now
## Campaign period:
November 12, 2026, 12:00 – November 30, 2026, 23:59 (UTC+8)
## How to participate:
1. Download the Bitget Wallet app, find the Referral Center and enter the referral code Bitget2026
2. Go to Wallet > Card, tap Apply now, complete identity verification, and successfully apply for and activate your card
3. Spend at least $5 with your card during the campaign to qualify for the prize draw. The more you spend, the higher your chance of winning
Campaign rules
1. Eligibility: During the campaign, users must use Bitget exchange referral code Bitget2026, activate their first Bitget Wallet Card, and reach an eligible spend of at least $5 to qualify for this campaign.
2. Prize draw: A single 500 USDC prize draw will be held if the campaign reaches 1,000 eligible participants. One winner will be selected through a draw, with higher card spending increasing the chance of winning. No draw will be held if the minimum participation requirement is not met
3. USDC reward: The first 1,000 eligible participants who spend at least $5 during the campaign will receive an additional 5 USDC on a first-come, first-served basis, while rewards last. This reward can be combined with the existing new-user spending reward of up to $20, for up to $25 in total card rewards. The existing reward will be distributed according to its applicable campaign rules
4. Reward distribution: Rewards will be credited to your Rewards Account in the Bitget Wallet app within seven business days after the campaign ends
6. Participation limit: Each verified identity, UID, and wallet address may participate only once. If any of these identifiers is used in multiple entries, the entries will be treated as one participant and counted only once
7. Bitget Wallet reserves the right to make final decisions regarding the interpretation of these rules. If fraud, rule violations, malicious arbitrage, or other conduct that undermines campaign fairness is detected, Bitget Wallet may, without prior notice, disqualify the participant or winner, recover rewards already distributed, and suspend or restrict related account features where appropriate

Venue: Bitget
Headline: Bitget Community Product Officer Program Returns! Share Your Product Experience & Win from 3,000 USDT!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Your Voice, Our Products.
The Bitget Community Product Officer Program is back and better than ever!
With three exciting product challenges covering the U.S. Stocks, CFDs, and AI, it's time to take your product experience to the next level. Share your insights, showcase your creativity, and compete for a share of the 3,000 USDT prize pool!
Join the upgraded Q4 Community Product Officer Program today. Your experience matters. Your voice shapes what's next!
Join Now.
## Campaign Period & Rewards
Campaign Period: November 16 – December 12, 2026
Campaign Format: Three themed product experience challenges, 9 days each
Total Prize Pool: 3,000 USDT
Total Winning Spots: 165 (55 per challenge)
Platform: X (Twitter)
Eligibility: All Bitget users
## Three Product Experience Challenges
The campaign features three challenges covering Bitget's key product areas. Each challenge comes with a
1,000 USDT prize pool. Participants can join the challenges that match their interests and product experience.
## Phase 1 | My Bitget U.S. Stock Product Experience
Campaign Period: November 16 – November 24
Prize Pool: 1,000 USDT
Explore Bitget's U.S. stock products, including rToken (tokenized stocks) and Stock Perps (stock perpetual futures), and share your real trading experiences.
## Suggested Topics:
rToken Experience: Share your experience with tokenized stocks, including trading processes, interface design, and ease of use.
Stock Perps Experience: Review order placement, leverage features, trading costs, and risk management tools.
Product Feature Reviews: Highlight your favorite U.S. stock trading features and explain their benefits and use cases.
Product Comparisons & Suggestions: Compare Bitget's U.S. stock products with other platforms and share their strengths and areas for improvement.
Recommended Formats: Trading screenshots, feature reviews, product comparisons, visual analyses, and short videos.
## Phase 2 | My Bitget CFD Product Experience
Campaign Period: November 25 – December 3
Explore Bitget's key CFD features and share your real experiences, product reviews, and suggestions for improvement.
CFD Demo Trading: Share your demo trading experience, trading process, and how the demo account helps you become familiar with CFD trading.
Customizable Leverage: Review leverage adjustment features, flexibility, ease of use, and risk management experience.
Professional Trading Platform: Share your experience with MT5, charting tools, and advanced trading features.
CFD Account Types: Review different account types, including Zero-Fee, ECN, Pro (invitation only), and Standard+, focusing on fees, spreads, and use cases.
Trading Experience & Suggestions: Evaluate order execution, trading costs, product features, and areas for improvement.
Recommended Formats: Demo trading screenshots, feature demonstrations, account comparisons, product reviews, and short videos.
## Phase 3 | My Bitget AI Product Experience
Campaign Period: December 4 – December 12
Explore Bitget's AI-powered products, GetAgent and Agent Hub, and discover how AI can support market analysis, trading research, and operational efficiency.
GetAgent Experience: Share your experience with AI interactions, market information searches, price analysis, and AI-powered trading assistance.
Agent Hub Exploration
: Explore different AI Agents and share their features, practical applications, and usefulness.
AI Trading Assistance Reviews: Evaluate how AI supports market research, information gathering, trading strategy analysis, and efficiency.
Product Improvement Suggestions: Provide feedback on feature design, response accuracy, user experience, and practical value.
Recommended Formats: AI conversation screenshots, feature demonstrations, product reviews, visual reports, and short videos.
## How to Participate
Step 1 | Join Bitget Product Fan Club
Join the Bitget Product Fan Club and participate as a Community Product Officer by exploring the featured products in each challenge.
Join Here.
Step 2 | Share Your Product Experience on X
Publish an original post on X related to the current challenge theme, sharing your real product experience, feature reviews, or improvement suggestions.
## Your post must include both campaign hashtags:
We encourage you to include product screenshots, demonstration videos, or detailed feature analyses to make your content more informative and valuable.
Step 3 | Submit Your Entry
After publishing your post, complete the campaign submission form with the following information:
Bitget UID
X post link
Campaign phase
Submission Link
Step 4 | Get Recognized & Rewarded
Bitget will evaluate submissions based on content quality, product experience depth, originality, and social engagement. Outstanding participants will have the opportunity to win USDT rewards.
## Campaign Rewards
The Q4 Community Product Officer Program offers a total prize pool of 3,000 USDT, with 1,000 USDT allocated to each phase and 165 winning spots across all three challenges.
## Reward Breakdown Per Phase:
Award Category | Winners | Reward per Winner
Best Product Review | 5 | 40 USDT
Most Valuable Feedback | 10 | 25 USDT
Best Creative Content | 10 | 20 USDT
Community Choice Award | 10 | 15 USDT
Participation Reward | 20 | 10 USDT
Total per Phase | 55 | 1,000 USDT Prize Pool
Total Across Three Phases: 165 Winning Spots and 3,000 USDT in Rewards.
The winners are scheduled to be announced on December 13, 2026, subject to the official announcement.
## Evaluation Criteria
All eligible submissions will be evaluated based on the following criteria:
Authenticity: Whether the content reflects genuine product usage and real-world experiences.
Depth of Product Experience: Whether the review provides detailed insights into specific product features and practical use cases.
Value of Feedback: Whether the suggestions are clear, constructive, and actionable.
Originality & Creativity: Whether the content is original and presents product experiences in an engaging way.
Community Engagement & Reach: The post's visibility, engagement, and overall social reach.
Priority will be given to authentic, insightful, and high-quality original content. Social engagement and reach will be considered as supporting factors rather than the sole criteria.
Valuable product feedback may also be collected and shared with the Bitget product team to support future product improvements.
## Campaign Rules & Terms
The campaign is open to all Bitget users. Participants must provide a valid Bitget UID and complete the required posting and submission steps.
All submissions must relate to the designated product theme of the corresponding phase and be based on genuine product experiences.
X posts must include both #BitgetCommunityProductOfficer and #BitgetFans.
Participants must publish their content within the corresponding campaign period and submit a valid X post link and required information through the designated form.
Plagiarism, copied content, fabricated feedback, artificial engagement, or other fraudulent activities are strictly prohibited and may result in disqualification.
Duplicate submissions of the same content will only be counted once. Posts must remain publicly accessible during the evaluation period for verification.
Rewards will be distributed based on the final evaluation results. The official winner announcement and reward distribution arrangements will be determined by Bitget.
Bitget reserves the right to modify and interpret the campaign rules to the extent permitted by applicable laws.

Venue: Aster
Headline: Anthropic Pre-IPO Showdown: 20,000 USDT Taker & PnL Clash

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
With Anthropic’s IPO on the horizon, market anticipation is heating up. Now, get ahead of the buzz with Aster!
Trade $ANT (Anthropic) in Aster’s Anthropic Pre-IPO Showdown, climb the leaderboard, and compete for your share of the 20,000 USDT prize pool.
## 🔍 What Is a Pre-IPO Perpetual
A Pre-IPO Perpetual trades on the market-implied price per share of a company that has not listed yet. These contracts do not represent equity or any claim on shares.
## Campaign Overview
- Eligible perpetual contract: ANTHROPICUSD1 (ANTUSD1), ANTHROPICUSDT (ANTUSDT)
- Campaign period: November 13, 14:00 UTC — December 12, 23:59 UTC
- Prize pool: 20,000 USDT
## Prize Pool Breakdown
## The 20,000 USDT prize pool is allocated as follows:
- Cumulative Taker Volume Leaderboard: 8,000 USDT
- Absolute Net USD PnL Leaderboard: 8,000 USDT
- Participation Pool: 4,000 USDT
Participants’ rankings will be displayed on the campaign landing page throughout the campaign period. If fewer eligible traders meet the minimum cumulative trading volume requirement, any unawarded rewards will not be distributed.
## 1. Cumulative Taker Volume Leaderboard: 8,000 USDT
40% of the prize pool (8,000 USDT) will be awarded to the Top 5 traders ranked by cumulative single-sided taker volume executed across the eligible trading pairs during the campaign period.
## Eligibility Requirements
To qualify for leaderboard rewards, users must meet the minimum cumulative taker trading volume requirement for their respective rank across the eligible trading pairs, as shown in the table below.
If these requirements are not met, the corresponding leaderboard rewards will not be awarded.
## 2. Absolute Net USD PnL Leaderboard: 8,000 USDT
40% of the prize pool (8,000 USDT) will be awarded to the Top 5 traders ranked by net trading profit (Realized + Unrealized USD PnL, net of funding and trading fees) across the eligible trading pairs during the campaign period.
- If a trader ranks by PnL without meeting the tier’s minimum volume requirement, they step down to the highest tier whose volume guardrail they satisfied.
- PnL will only be calculated for positions opened during the campaign period.
- Participants may win rewards from both leaderboards if they meet the eligibility requirements.
## 3. Participation Pool: 4,000 USDT
20% of the prize pool (4,000 USDT) will be shared equally among eligible participants, with each participant receiving up to 50 USDT.
- Achieve a cumulative taker trading volume of at least $50,000 USD across the eligible trading pairs during the campaign period.
- Not receive rewards from Taker Volume or PnL leaderboards.
## Note
- The campaign is open to all new and existing Aster users, excluding market makers.
- Sub-accounts are not eligible for separate registration. Trading volume generated by all sub-accounts will be automatically consolidated under the corresponding main account.
- Participation in this campaign requires Account Privacy to be disabled. Participants’ wallet addresses and trading volumes will be publicly displayed.
- Only trades executed on eligible trading pairs via Aster Perpetuals during the campaign period will be counted toward reward calculations, including trades made through Binance Wallet, Trust Wallet, SafePal, and other supported channels.
- Only reward amounts equal to or greater than 1 USDT will be distributed. Rewards will be distributed to participants’ Aster Perpetual accounts within 14 business days after the campaign ends.
- As Anthropic’s IPO approaches, Aster reserves the right to rebase its Pre-IPO Perpetual contracts. Traders may need to close existing positions and reopen them. Please monitor official announcements and adjust your positions accordingly to avoid potential losses.
- Trading volume and realized PnL from the eligible Pre-IPO Perpetuals pair will continue to count toward the campaign leaderboard calculations following its transition to a regular Perpetuals pair during the campaign period.
## Terms & Conditions
- Activities identified as wash trading, self-trading, manipulative volume generation, wallet-splitting, or any other abusive behaviors will result in disqualification. Sybil farming behaviors will be filtered.
- Due to the inherent volatility of digital asset markets, returns from any Aster trading campaign may fluctuate and are not guaranteed.
- Aster may amend or modify campaign rules at any time without prior notice.
- Aster retains the final right of interpretation for this event.
- Aster will not be responsible or liable for any losses (including, without limitation, any direct or indirect damages for loss of profits) resulting or arising directly or indirectly from your participation in this campaign.

Headline: Get up to $100 in BTC with our Black Friday Deposit & Trade Bonus

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
## TL;DR
- Our Black Friday Deposit & Trade Bonus runs from November 12 to December 1, 2026, with rewards of up to $100 in BTC per client.
- Enroll first in the Rewards Hub in the Kraken app, then deposit $1,000 in fiat and trade to unlock four stacked milestones: $10, then an extra $15, $25 and $50.
- Only external fiat deposits and Instant Buy trades made after you enroll count toward your milestones.
- Rewards are paid in Bitcoin (BTC) and held on Kraken until January 1. You can still trade or stake your BTC in the meantime.
This Black Friday, your deposit earns more. With our new Black Friday Deposit & Trade Bonus, you can deposit $1,000 in fiat, trade the way you normally would and get up to $100 in BTC. Rewards stack across four milestones, so the more you trade, the more you can unlock.
## How the Black Friday Deposit & Trade Bonus works
## Getting started takes three steps:
- Enroll first. Opt in through the Rewards Hub in the Kraken app. Deposits and trades made before you enroll don’t count toward any milestone.
- Deposit $1,000 in fiat. Fiat deposits only, made after you enroll and before the offer ends.
- Trade to unlock each milestone. Complete eligible Instant Buy trades to earn your way up to $100 in BTC.
The offer starts November 12 at 2:00 p.m. UTC (9:00 a.m. ET) and ends December 1 at 2:00 p.m. UTC, the day after Cyber Monday.
## Four stacked milestones, up to $100 in BTC
Each milestone adds to the last, and each one can be earned once. The maximum reward is $100 in BTC per client.
Milestone | What you do | Reward | Total reward so far
Milestone 1 | Deposit $1,000 in fiat and trade $1,000 | $10 in BTC | $10
Milestone 2 | Trade $2,500 in total | An extra $15 in BTC | $25
Milestone 3 | Trade $5,000 in total | An extra $25 in BTC | $50
Milestone 4 | Trade $10,000 in total | An extra $50 in BTC | $100
Each reward is a set dollar amount paid out in BTC. Three-quarters of the maximum reward sits at Milestones 3 and 4, so the biggest payouts go to the clients who trade the most.
## What counts toward the bonus
- Eligible trades: Instant Buy trades made after you enroll. Trades between fiat and stablecoins, or within stablecoins, don’t count. Trades of stocks, xStocks and Bundles don’t count either, and neither do derivatives and margin trades.
## A Black Friday example
## Here’s how the offer could play out from start to finish:
- November 12: You see the offer by email, push notification or an Explore card and enroll in the Rewards Hub.
- November 27 (Black Friday): You deposit $1,000 in fiat, then keep trading through Instant Buy until you reach $10,000 in total eligible trades. You’ve now completed all four milestones and earned $100 in BTC.
- Within 14 days of each milestone: Your BTC reward is paid out.
- December: You can trade or stake your BTC on Kraken while it’s held.
- January 1: Your BTC can be withdrawn.
## When you get paid and when you can withdraw
We pay each reward within 14 days of completing the milestone. Your BTC is held on Kraken until December 31, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. UTC and can be withdrawn from January 1, 2027. While it’s held, you can still trade it or stake it on Kraken.
Keep in mind that BTC rewards can go up or down in value.
## Who can participate
The Black Friday Deposit & Trade Bonus is available to eligible clients in:
- United States: 47 states and Washington D.C. (excluding Florida, Maine, and New York)
- European Economic Area and other eligible countries
The offer is not available in the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Switzerland, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Turkey, Russia, Brazil, Puerto Rico or sanctioned regions. See the full terms and conditions for details.
## Enroll, deposit, trade
Enroll in the Rewards Hub first, deposit $1,000 in fiat and trade your way to up to $100 in BTC before the offer ends on December 1 at 2:00 p.m. UTC.

1. Queueing rules: exclusive quota is allocated in order of the first subscription time corresponding to each queued amount, with the VIP round and the public round calculating allocations and unallocated funds separately.Unallocated funds from the VIP round are ranked by each user's first subscription time in the VIP round, and unallocated funds from the public round are ranked by each user's first subscription time in the public round.A single user's unallocated funds from the VIP round and the public round each form one separate queue entry.
